title: Northstar synthetic plan: emergency care cost sharing
source: CC0 synthetic training fixture; fictional policy statement
text: TRAINING FIXTURE — FICTIONAL POLICY. In the Northstar sample plan, emergency department services for a sudden condition that a reasonable person would consider an emergency use the same 150 dollar copayment whether the facility is in network or out of network. This fictional rule applies only to emergency department evaluation, not routine follow-up, ambulance transport, or scheduled specialty care. The sample benefit summary does not explain balance billing, stabilization, or the full legal protections that may apply in a real jurisdiction. It must not be used to decide whether an actual symptom is an emergency or to delay urgent care. If a person may be in immediate danger, they should seek local emergency help rather than rely on a plan document. Questions about follow-up coverage are not answered here and require a separate source. The named plan and all amounts are fictional retrieval-test data.
